source_label: Authored planner content: John Boyd's orientation and destruction-and-creation ideas (paraphrased), Venkatesh Rao's writing on OODA and tempo (marked as interpretation), and Yu Jie Teo's notes OODA, Orientation, and Slouching
assumptions: This is a planner, not a dataset: the worked examples, operation catalogue, prompts and methodology are authored for this page and stored in raw.json.
Boyd's ideas are paraphrased, never quoted; his papers and briefings are cited by title and date without links.
Rao material appears only as labelled interpretations drawing on the cited essays and book.
The Southwest-style example and the short cards are applications from Yu Jie Teo's notes, not Boyd case studies; their details are illustrative.
User situations are stored only in the browser that created them; nothing is uploaded.
